beats.say: The first video ever shown on MTV had a very fitting title.
On 1 August 1981, MTV opened with Video Killed the Radio Star, by The Buggles.
The title says it all: video was coming for radio.
And the rest of that launch?
Pat Benatar, Rod Stewart, The Who and Cliff Richard were all part of it.
What song would you play to launch a music channel today?
